key_insight: Progressive structural reasoning disentangles object structure from motion cues so a single image suffices to stably recover articulated 3D geometry and joint parameters.
problem_solved: How to jointly infer object geometry, part structure, and articulation from a single image despite the entanglement between motion cues and object structure that makes direct articulation regression unstable.
method: Coarse-to-fine pipeline that first predicts part-level structure and a kinematic graph, then refines geometry and joint parameters progressively to reduce entanglement between structure and motion.

Intermediate, part-centric representations and constrained articulation regression (e.g., kinematic priors / differentiable joint transforms) to stabilize single-image pose and shape estimation without multi-view or retrieval lookups.
Efficient single-image training and inference with self-consistency / reconstruction losses to scale to diverse articulated categories while maintaining accuracy.
impact: Enables accurate, scalable monocular recovery of articulated 3D objects for applications in robotics, AR/VR, and animation, reducing reliance on multi-view data or costly retrieval/video pipelines.
